name: markdown
description: Marksman uses native .marksman.toml at the workspace root. [core] markdown.file_extensions is an array without dots; text_sync is full or incremental. The config file also identifies a workspace when .git is absent. It diagnoses link integrity; it does not have an ordinary Markdown syntax-error switch in settings. Reporting limitation: this Marksman version publishes only when a diagnostic set changes. It does not support textDocument/diagnostic pull requests, and opening a clean file can produce no diagnostic notification. The built-in client therefore stays silent when a new edit yields no fresh report; this is not proof that the file is clean or broken. Changing settings, waiting longer, or reopening a clean file cannot guarantee a new report. Use Marksman for link-change findings with this limitation, or attach a different/custom checker that explicitly reports each completed check when every-edit confirmation is required.
